facts.business: Nukleus Office Solutions Limited provides integrated, flexible, and fully managed office solutions including coworking spaces, managed offices, private offices, dedicated desks, meeting rooms, virtual offices, and build-to-suit solutions across Delhi NCR and beyond.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: 1. Non-capitalization of new Bangalore centre due to unresolved issues with landlord (Note 32(xi)). 2. Capitalization of certain portion of expenses towards new operating centres under development (Note 32(xii)). 3. Deferment and amortization of expenses incurred for enhancing brand recognition over 4 years (Note 32(xiii)).

key_risks: Capitalization of expenditure for centre development involves significant management judgement
Capitalization of corporate branding expenditure requires judgement in distinguishing from routine advertising
Revenue recognition involves significant management judgement due to volume of transactions and varying contract terms
